plan.notes: Source: UAFS 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog program page (poid=1288). Admission requires 15 hrs of 10000-level ART foundation courses and passing ARTS 15551 - Admissions Portfolio. Grade C or better in all ARTS/ARHS/GDES; 2.75 GPA in major. World language 8 hrs. Additional degree requirements 20 hrs (12 upper-level; minor required). Total_credits = sequenced sum = 120. Transcribed 2026-10-01 from a live-browser harvest of the official catalog.
